# Cairn

> Cairn is an open-source, self-hosted personal assistant for people who write code. Agents run on your own machines using your model subscriptions or API keys. Each person runs their own copy; there is no hosted service.

- License: Apache-2.0
- Install: `npx @xiechimon/cairn` (Node.js 22 or 24; Linux or macOS server, Windows with a pairing step)
- Source: https://github.com/xiechimon/cairn

The server hosts the web app, Coordinator and database. Runners execute work on your machines. A model source is also required. Agents ask before irreversible actions such as deleting data, payments, changing credentials or publishing. Mail, calendar and job search are planned, not shipped.

## English documentation

- [Overview](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/intro/): What Cairn is, its three pieces, and who it is for.
- [Install](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/install/): Requirements, starting the server, backups and private phone access.
- [Connect a model](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/models/): Subscriptions, API keys and compatible endpoints.
- [Connect a Runner](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/runner/): Machine enrollment and keeping a Runner online.
- [Your first task](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/first-task/): Create a project and follow a task to a result.
- [FAQ](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/faq/): Cost, privacy, limitations and troubleshooting.
